title: Add a pure function with a documented contract
instruction: In the repository at the current working directory, open src/math.mjs. Add and export a function `clamp(value, min, max)` that returns `value` limited to the inclusive range [min, max]. It must throw a RangeError if min > max. Do not change any other function. Use the file-editing tool; do not paste the whole file back as text.
